# stratusphere/bicep/main.bicep

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Stratusphere UX appliances (Hub, Database, Collectors) in Azure for AVD readiness assessments.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `namePrefix` | string |  | Short prefix (lowercase letters/digits, 2-8 chars). Resource names derive from this. |
| `environment` | string | `''` | Optional environment segment (dev, test, prod) so the resource group matches rg-<prefix>-<env>-* for deadline teardown. |
| `location` | string | `deployment().location` | Azure region for all resources. |
| `tags` | object | `{}` | Extra tags merged onto the resource group and every resource. |
| `imagePublisher` | string | `'liquidware'` | Marketplace publisher of the Stratusphere images. |
| `imageOffer` | string | `'stratusphere'` | Marketplace offer of the Stratusphere images. |
| `imageVersion` | string | `'latest'` | Image version for every appliance, or latest. |
| `deployHub` | bool | `true` | Deploy the Hub. Turned off only to change other roles without touching it. |
| `hubImagePlan` | string |  | Marketplace plan (SKU) of the Hub. The preflight lists the plans offered in your region. |
| `hubVmSize` | string | `'Standard_D4s_v5'` | Hub VM size. Liquidware lists 4 vCPU and 16 GB as the Hub minimum. |
| `hubOsDiskSizeGB` | int | `128` | OS disk size in GB for the Hub. Liquidware lists 60 GB as the minimum; the database grows with endpoints and retention. |
| `hubPrivateIp` | string | `'(address in the source)'` | Static private IP of the Hub, inside hubSubnetPrefix (Azure reserves the first four addresses). |
| `deployDatabase` | bool | `false` | Deploy the Database appliance. Liquidware advises one above 1,000 Connector ID Keys. |
| `databaseImagePlan` | string | `''` | Marketplace plan (SKU) of the Database appliance. Required when deployDatabase is true. |
| `databaseVmSize` | string | `'Standard_D4s_v5'` | Database VM size. Liquidware lists 4 vCPU and 16 GB as the minimum. |
| `databaseOsDiskSizeGB` | int | `256` | OS disk size in GB for the Database appliance. |
| `databasePrivateIp` | string | `'(address in the source)'` | Static private IP of the Database appliance. |
| `collectorCount` | int | `0` | Number of Collector appliances (0 for none). |
| `collectorImagePlan` | string | `''` | Marketplace plan (SKU) of the Collector appliance. Required when collectorCount is above 0. |
| `collectorVmSize` | string | `'Standard_D2s_v5'` | Collector VM size. Liquidware lists 2 vCPU and 8 GB as the minimum. |
| `collectorOsDiskSizeGB` | int | `64` | OS disk size in GB for each Collector. |
| `collectorPrivateIps` | array | `(see the file)` | Static private IPs of the Collectors, in order. Needs at least collectorCount entries. |
| `autoShutdownTime` | string | `'2000'` | Daily auto-shutdown time in HHmm (24-hour) for every appliance VM, or empty to disable. |
| `autoShutdownTimeZone` | string | `'Central Standard Time'` | Windows time zone ID for the daily auto-shutdown schedule. |
| `adminUsername` | string | `'ssadmin-azure'` | Local administrator name Azure sets on every appliance. |
| `adminPassword` | string |  | Local administrator password Azure sets on every appliance. The deploy scripts generate one, store it in Key Vault and reuse it on later runs. |
| `addressPrefix` | string | `'(address in the source)'` | Address space of the assessment VNet. |
| `hubSubnetPrefix` | string | `'(address in the source)'` | Subnet for the appliances: Hub, Database and Collectors. |
| `bastionSubnetPrefix` | string | `'(address in the source)'` | AzureBastionSubnet prefix (/26 or larger). Used only when deployBastion is true. |
| `callbackSourcePrefixes` | array | `(see the file)` | Source prefixes allowed to reach the Hub on TCP 443: the endpoints running the Connector ID Key and the admins using the web console. |
| `peerVirtualNetworkResourceId` | string | `''` | Optional VNet to peer with both ways (for example the avd-landing-zone spoke whose session hosts will run the Connector ID Key). Empty for none. |
| `deployBastion` | bool | `true` | Deploy Azure Bastion (Basic) for the appliance console. |
| `keyVaultReaderObjectId` | string |  | Object ID of the user or group allowed to read the appliance credential from Key Vault (the deploy scripts pass the signed-in user). |
| `keyVaultReaderPrincipalType` | string | `'User'` | Principal type of keyVaultReaderObjectId. |
